title: Visible Yet Unreadable: A Systematic Blind Spot of Vision–Language Models Across Writing Systems

contributions.purpose: 揭示VLM跨书写系统的'可见但不可读'失败模式
contributions.mechanism: 对多个前沿/开源VLM测试拼接/重组/叠加后仍对人类可读的中文成语与英文词
contributions.evaluation: 中文strict match普遍<5%(Qwen avg 24%为最高),英文即使详细提示≤20%,人类基线100%
contributions.domain: 视觉语言模型/机器识字
contributions.source_quote: state-of-the-art VLMs exhibit a marked collapse on “visible-but-unreadable” stimuli—perturbations that remain trivial for humans across logographic and alphabetic scripts

contributions.purpose: 构建心理物理启发的跨书写系统基准
contributions.mechanism: 100条四字成语(水平/垂直/对角切割融合)+100个八字母词(两半异色叠加)
contributions.evaluation: 受控扰动保持人类可读性同时系统性挑战机器,附提示设计与strict+相似度双指标
contributions.source_quote: We introduce controlled perturbations for Chinese idioms and English words that preserve human readability while systematically challenging machine recognition

contributions.purpose: 证明难度梯度源于模型架构盲点而非任务固有
contributions.mechanism: 对比人类与模型在'难/易'样本上的识别率分布
contributions.evaluation: 人类对难易项均近满分无梯度,模型难度谱(0%~55.6%)为架构缺陷所致
contributions.source_quote: difficulty for VLMs is an artifact of model limitations rather than an inherent property of the task

self_declared_provenance.quote: Whereas [27] highlight the potential for models to benefit from sub-character information in Chinese, we highlight a broader architectural blind spot across both logographic and alphabetic scripts

notes: 全文核心即负结果(VLM近乎全面失败);评测较严谨(strict+相似度双指标,2 runs,10人真实人类基线,含难度分析Fig5/6);数据可信度较好(真实公开API/开源checkpoint,Table3细粒度)。局限:仅2种书写系统与受控扰动。代码'release upon acceptance'。AI披露:GPT-5起草与文献综合、Claude Code实验实现与画表、Gemini 2.5 Pro画框架图,假设[B]、实验设计/分析/写作[C];AI自述局限:表面推理、复杂示意图能力不足。四篇声明贡献第4条'broader impact'为非实证,未单列。accept。
